salesLanguage.headline: MX-0403-H3-MST: runs a dual-display collaboration room and creates a useful third feed
salesLanguage.plainEnglishSummary: Use this when a room needs more than simple screen switching. It lets users connect laptops by USB-C or HDMI, show content across two room displays, handle USB for collaboration devices, and send an additional output to another destination.
salesLanguage.customerValue: It helps a meeting room behave like a complete collaboration space: local presentation, dual-screen working, USB device sharing, and an extra hand-off feed for the wider system.
salesLanguage.realWorldApplication: Best for boardrooms, teaching spaces and Teams-style rooms where the in-room displays are not the only destination for the content.
salesLanguage.salespersonCue: Position the third output as the room's hand-off point, not just another display output.
talkTrack: It gives the room two main display outputs for local presentation, then keeps a third output available for capture, conferencing or distribution.
The third output is useful when the customer wants the same room signal available to a Teams Rooms PC, recorder, streaming device or AVoIP encoder.
This is a room-core product: it is about making the room easier to use, not just adding another switch in the rack.
discoveryPrompts: Will the third output feed a Microsoft Teams Rooms PC, a recording device, or an AVoIP encoder?
Do the two room displays need independent content, mirrored content, or MST-style dual-screen behaviour?
Where will the USB camera, microphone or speakerphone connect, and which laptop should control it?
Does the room content need to be recorded, streamed, or distributed outside the room?
positioningNotes: Lead with the room workflow: laptop in, displays on, USB devices available, third feed out.
Use when the customer needs a meeting-room core with USB-C, HDMI, USB and an HDBaseT output path.
The third output can be a practical bridge from the local room into Teams, recording or NetworkHD/AVoIP distribution.
avoidPositioningAs: Do not describe it as only a 4x3 matrix. That undersells the room workflow.
Do not use it as a generic distribution product when the real requirement is large-scale routing.
salesLanguage.thirdOutputUseCase: The third output is designed for a Microsoft Teams Rooms PC, a recording or lecture-capture device, or an AV-over-IP encoder when the room signal needs to leave the room and join a wider system.

technicalLines: 1x Analog Audio Out (5-pin Phoenix Male Connector)
USB-C IN/HDMI IN/ HDMI OUT: Up to 7.1ch, including PCM 2.0/5.1/7.1ch, Dolby Digital, Dolby Digital Plus, Dolby TrueHD, Dolby Atmos,
DTS 5.1, DTS-HD Master Audio and DTS:X.
All HDR formats, including HDR 10, HLG, HDR 10+ and Dolby Vision
Supports firmware updates via the Web UI and offers multiple methods to restore factory settings, ensuring the device stays up-to-date and easy to troubleshoot.
Supports up to 4K@60Hz 4:4:4 video resolution on all HDMI inputs and outputs, ensuring superior visual quality for your presentations.
Supports a wide range of audio formats, including PCM 2.0/5.1/7.1ch, Dolby Digital, Dolby TrueHD, Dolby Atmos, DTS-HD Master Audio, and DTS, delivering an immersive audio experience.
Offers multiple control methods, including RS232, Telnet, and a user-friendly Web UI, allowing for convenient management and configuration of the switcher.
Features automatic switching modes such as last-in-first-out and priority settings, ensuring the most relevant input source is always displayed
Supports USB-C dual video mode, allowing one USB-C connection to transmit two independent video streams to two HDMI outputs
Provides the ability to switch USB and video signals independently, offering greater flexibility in managing connected devices.
Compatible with mainstream audio DSPs and video bars, including brands such as Q-SYS, Shure, Biamp, Extron, Yealink, Logitech and more. For details, please refer to the USB compatibility list
Compatible with Microsoft Teams Rooms(MTR), like Lenovo ThinkSmart Core Gen 1/2 devices.
Includes a balanced audio de-embedding port for connecting to audio equipment, ensuring high-quality audio output.
All ports support cable lock connections to ensure stable and secure connections for all devices during presentations.
Dual RJ-45 ports support Ethernet switching and VLAN settings, providing reliable network connectivity and enhanced security.
